hints.title: Initial Element Parameterization
hints.text: Express every element copy[i] in terms of copy[0] plus the offset original[i] - original[0].

hints.title: Constraint Translation via Offsets
hints.text: Each bound bounds[i] translates to a constraint on copy[0]: bounds[i][0] - offset <= copy[0] <= bounds[i][1] - offset.

hints.title: 1D Interval Intersection
hints.text: Intersect the intervals for copy[0] across all indices. The answer is max(0, high - low + 1).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains running intersection of valid ranges for the initial element copy[0].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating possible values of copy elements causes TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Translating bounds to the single variable copy[0] eliminates combinatorial searching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 1D interval intersection derived from linear difference equations.
